integrity: The argument is self-contained and acknowledges the previously established endpoint setup and temporal approximation framework. Finite exact-arithmetic tests supplement but do not replace an arbitrary-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional SPD-contractive, time-independent propagators; one exact FCF-relaxed two-level sweep with copied initial vector at every point; infinite coarse-interval endpoint limit and repeated restarts; no nonsymmetric, stochastic, finite-precision or finite-horizon uniform stability claims. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: A sharp noncommuting stability frontier for restarted two-level optimization
